01 · The list

Every word,
in exam order

HSK 1 is the first of the six HSK levels. Its list holds 150 words: the pronouns, numbers, verbs and everyday nouns the HSK 1 exam is built from. Every entry below shows the hanzi, pinyin with tone marks, an English meaning and a real example sentence with its own reading and translation.

In Lock&Learn Chinese this list is the HSK 1 pack: a word waits in hanzi with its pinyin; one tap reveals the meaning and a real sentence. HSK 1 is free in the app.

Type to filter by hanzi, pinyin or meaning. Flashcards hides the meaning until you tap a row; Shuffle deals the list in a new order.

03 · Questions

Asked and
answered

How many words are in the HSK 1 vocabulary list?

150. The six-level HSK syllabus adds about 150, 150, 300, 600, 1,300 and 2,500 new words per level, about 5,000 in all; this page lists the words that are new at HSK 1, not the cumulative total.

Is this the official HSK HSK 1 word list?

It follows the official six-level HSK syllabus (HSK 2.0), the list the HSK 1 to 6 exams are still administered on. The HSK 3.0 standard published in 2021 reorganises vocabulary into nine bands and is not what this page shows.

How do I study the HSK 1 list on my iPhone Lock Screen?

Install Lock&Learn Chinese, then touch and hold your Lock Screen, tap Customize, tap the widget area and choose Lock&Learn Chinese. The HSK 1 pack puts these words on the widget one at a time: you recall the meaning, one tap reveals it with a real sentence. HSK 1 is free in the app.

Can I download the HSK 1 vocabulary list as a PDF?

Yes. Use your browser's Print or Save as PDF: the page has a print layout that keeps only the heading and the full table, every word on this list.

Is Lock&Learn Chinese free?

Yes. The app is free on iOS: HSK 1 is free, every other pack opens with a free preview, and another word unlocks daily. Lock&Learn+ is an optional upgrade that opens every pack at once, offered as a yearly plan or a one-time lifetime purchase.
